stale.title: Data may be stale
stale.message: The latest values are temporarily unavailable. Previously loaded data remains visible.

aiSpend.title: Helix spend watch
aiSpend.insufficient: Fewer than 3 active days in the prior week; there is not enough history for a pace comparison.
aiSpend.quiet: No audited AI spend recorded today.
aiSpend.projection: At the current pace: approximately {{amount}} by UTC midnight.
aiSpend.unusual: Spend is pacing at least twice the prior-week daily average. This is an estimate, not a billing alert.
aiSpend.newPaid: Paid AI usage appeared today after a week of zero recorded spend. Check the contributing provider and model.
aiSpend.capRisk: At this pace you may reach the global daily cap ({{amount}}) before UTC midnight.
aiSpend.driver: Largest observed contributor: {{feature}} via {{provider}} / {{model}} ({{amount}} today; {{baseline}} prior daily average).
aiSpend.caveat: Based on recorded AI calls only. Delayed or missing audit records can undercount; projections assume today’s pace continues.

partial.title: Partial data
partial.message: Some sources did not respond. Available results remain visible and are not treated as complete.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.message: A required service is unavailable. This section will recover when the dependency returns.

unsupported.title: Feature not supported
unsupported.message: This feature is not enabled by the current deployment configuration.
